The denonavr library has been pushed to a new version 0.9.0, so this is now ready to be merged :)
Version 0.9.0 includes this PR wich is needed for Config Flow: https://github.com/scarface-4711/denonavr/pull/132

YAML configuration of the denonavr component has been deprecated, please remove the denonavr platform from your configuration.yaml file.
The denonavr component now uses the new Config Flow.
Denon and Marantz receivers should be discovered automatically and show up under "Configuration"-> "Integrations", from there hit configure and go through the steps, all previous setting options are still available during this setup.
If your receiver does not show up automatically, go to "Configuration"-> "Integrations"-> press the "+" icon -> search for "denonavr" and enter the setup.

- Implement Config Flow
- Implement the new SSDP discovery using Config Flow
- Set device_ids and set unique ids for the receiver and there zones.
- Remove the depricated discovery implementation.
